import createBrowserRouter.description: Data mode router using the History API.

createBrowserRouter().description:
The standard Data mode router. Pass the tree to `<RouterProvider router={router} />`.
Use `Component`/`ErrorBoundary` (component refs) or `element`/`errorElement` (JSX) — not both for the same slot.

createHashRouter().description: Stores the location in the URL hash. For static hosts that cannot rewrite all paths to index.html.

createMemoryRouter().description: Keeps history in memory. The router of choice for tests and non-browser environments.

import createRoutesFromElements.description: Build a route array from JSX `<Route>` elements.

createRoutesFromElements().description: Declare Data mode routes as JSX instead of objects. Handy when migrating from a `<Routes>` tree.

import createStaticHandler.description: Server-side data loading for a custom SSR setup.

createStaticHandler().description:
Runs loaders/actions on the server for a request, producing the context an SSR render needs.
Only for hand-rolled SSR — Framework mode does this for you.

createStaticRouter().description: Builds the router that `<StaticRouterProvider>` renders on the server.

import createRoutesStub.description: Test helper that renders components needing router context.

createRoutesStub().description:
Renders a component with real router context, stubbed loaders and actions.
The supported way to test components that call `useLoaderData()`, `<Form>` or the navigation hooks.
